answer: Beacon-gated entry lottery admits agents by hashing registrations into a public random beacon drawn after cutoff, so attackers cannot precompute winners. Only winners receive a transaction thread; losers must submit a fresh proof-of-work sample equal to one canyon before retrying after cooldown. Every retry also needs a distinct terrace receipt bound to a unique device check, so each identity attempt costs real compute plus a non-reusable registration fee.
